visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, dressed in a vibrant, floor-length red sleeveless gown with a high leg slit and open back, stands on a red-carpeted stage. She holds a silver transverse flute to her lips, playing with focused facial expressions. Behind her is a professional stage setup featuring a blue backdrop with large white characters, audio equipment on stands, and a black laptop. The lighting is bright and even, characteristic of an indoor event space. (2) As she continues to play, she integrates rhythmic dance movements, swaying her hips and occasionally lifting her leg through the dress slit to reveal high-heeled shoes. Animated heart icons float above her head briefly. Small cartoon anime character overlays appear at the bottom of the screen, dancing in sync with her movements. Her facial expressions remain cheerful, occasionally smiling while maintaining her flute embouchure. (3) The performer executes more complex steps, turning slightly while maintaining the flute's position and continuing the melody. The camera remains fixed in a full-body shot, capturing the interaction between her instrumental performance and the choreographed dance. The background remains constant throughout this sequence, emphasizing the live event atmosphere.
